questions.question: Confirm the 10 shortage-test decisions (in docs/research/2026-10-09-ai-engineering-experts/shortage-test/protocol.md)? D01 writer-model switch; D02 ground truth for whether the library helps agents; D03 how much of a two-judge panel to audit; D04 unbiased relevance labels; D05 hybrid fusion when one leg misses; D06 who owns multi-step retrieval and when it stops; D07 validating agent citations; D08 outreach draft gate strictness; D09 evaluator evidence quotes; D10 sharing backlog decisions between advisory models and the owner.

options.label: Confirm all 10 (Recommended)
options.description: Five are evals, two retrieval, plus memory/provenance, review/verification and orchestration. Four were your own settled calls (D01, D02, D03, D08).

options.label: Swap some out
options.description: Name which to replace. 10 more candidates are in reserve (judge-panel failure rules, small-sample reporting, gold-set pass criteria, thresholds on small held-out sets, lexical admission, first-screen layout, display-size evidence, note identity lines, false factual flags, composite-score sub-metrics).

questions.question: Confirm the frozen numbers? Originals per X seed: 20. Harvest cap when the gate fails: 5 items. Evidence per arm per decision: 5 items. Items sampled per channel: 5 (a channel needs 5 graded to set standing). Collector bar: 4 of 8.

options.label: Confirm as listed (Recommended)
options.description: Matches the plan's 'about 20', 'about 5' and the precedent's 8-item feed bar. Five items per channel keeps paid calls modest and matches the marketing study's 2-5 episodes per person.

options.label: Change some
options.description: Say which number and the new value.

questions.question: How many library-new A items should a person's best channel need before they get harvest lines (otherwise they are tracked)?

options.label: 2 items (Recommended)
options.description: Experts repeat one core thesis, so 3 library-new methods in a 5-item sample is a high bar. With 2, Drew's line-by-line approval and the shortage gate's cap are the remaining checks.

options.label: 3 items
options.description: The drafter's choice. Stricter; fewer harvest proposals, more people tracked.
